adversarial_finding.title: The crawl page itself (_coverage_card, 'Against the FlowSpec' section) renders the SAME spec_error RAW, unscrubbed -- the fake secret 'hunter2' appeared verbatim in the browser DOM
adversarial_finding.location:
src/autotester/ui/routes_crawls.py:115 -- `f"

{escape(spec_error)}

"` -- escape() only, no redactor.scrub()
adversarial_finding.reproduced: directly observed in the live accessibility snapshot of http://127.0.0.1:8095/projects/demo/crawls/crawl_01M3F45W1NTZ22XAB65GQXSKCK -- the 'Against the FlowSpec' paragraph read '...input_value=''hunter2''...' in full, while the unrelated 'Run detail' table's 'FlowSpec screens reached' row on the SAME page showed the SAME message already scrubbed to '[REDACTED]:DEMO_PASSWORD'. Traced the second path to src/autotester/stages/crawl_coverage.py:96-113 `of_run()`: `scrub = rt.session.secrets.scrub_optional; ... spec_error = scrub(f"could not read the FlowSpec -- {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")` -- this ALREADY-SCRUBBED value is what gets persisted onto the Crawl record at crawl-finish time (AT-472, predates AT-593), which is what the Run-detail table reads back. _coverage_card, by contrast, recomputes spec_error fresh at RENDER time via `_load_flowspec_safe(store)` with zero redactor in scope.
adversarial_finding.scope_note: pre-existing since AT-477, NOT introduced by AT-593's diff -- _coverage_card is explicitly the untouched function per the manifest, and this diff never touches it. Not a regression from this unit. But it is a live, reproducible secret-to-browser-DOM leak sitting one function away from the one AT-593 just fixed, using the exact same spec_error string and the exact same redactor the fix now threads through -- _coverage_card has no redactor argument at all right now.
adversarial_finding.severity: high (real, currently-exploitable: any operator or anyone with access to the crawl page sees the raw credential in cleartext HTML -- CLAUDE.md's own hard rule is 'logs pass Redactor.scrub', and core/redact.py's docstring states the goal even more broadly: a secret value must never reach a log OR an artifact -- a rendered HTML page an operator is looking at is a materially worse exposure surface than a log file, since it requires zero shell/log access)
adversarial_finding.suggested_fix: thread a Redactor into _coverage_card exactly the same way this unit just threaded one into _queue_coverage_gap, and scrub spec_error before escape() at line 115 (both call sites of _coverage_card -- the crawl page and the merge page -- would need the redactor available; project.write_policy/SecretStore.load(project, paths.env_file, strict=False).redactor() is the same 'one loader' pattern already used twice in this codebase)
